## Read in Downloaded GEO counts:

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(tidyverse)
library(Orpheus)
seurat_obj = readRDS("../../20240529.snTC.integrated.rpca.RDS")
```

Take TauFisher clustering:

```{r}
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters")
```

Add ZT information to Seurat object:

```{r}
table(seurat_obj$day, seurat_obj$orig.ident)
#So ZT00 is from day 'two', all other time points are from day 1

matches <- stringr::str_match(seurat_obj$orig.ident , "ZT(\\d+)\\w+$")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
seurat_obj$ZT = ZT
```

## Now do Methods of Moments analysis (ORPHEUS)

```{r}

cluster_phis = list()
for(cluster_id in unique(seurat_obj$seurat_clusters)){
  tmp =extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cluster_id)

  pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
  var_mat = tmp[[2]]
  
  matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "ZT(\\d+)\\w+$")
  ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
  
  phi_preds = Orpheus::calc_phi(ZT, pb_mat, var_mat)
  var_cycling(ZT, var_mat[rownames(phi_preds), ], pb_mat[rownames(phi_preds),], plot_me = rownames(phi_preds))
  cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(phi_preds))

}


```
